name: simplify-code
description: Remove unnecessary layers and obsolete code, centralize shared rules, and verify the behavior that must survive.

interface.longDescription: A focused refactoring workflow for tracing ownership, checking dynamic and public entrypoints, removing obsolete layers through their callers, and preserving required behavior with proportionate checks.
defaultPrompt: Simplify this module by removing unnecessary wrappers and obsolete code.
Find repeated rules in this change and give each shared responsibility one clear owner.
